Design System
Chart/Data point
A single value on a line or scatter. Hidden on dense lines and shown on hover; Anomaly marks an AI-detected outlier. 3 variants.
Overview
What it is and when to reach for it.
When to use
Hover / focus feedback on Chart/Line and Chart/Live.
Last value of a line, to anchor the eye.
Outliers flagged by a model (Anomaly).

Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Show all points only when there are ≤ 24 per series.

Anomaly always comes with a reason in the tooltip or an AI insight.
